title: Typing past a character limit must keep the text and say how many characters are too many
summary: The character count leaves the textarea's hard maxlength in place, so typing is silently cut off at the limit and the user is never told the text is too long.
consumer: Author-written problem-report form around the unchanged upstream character count source at buggyCommit; an import map resolves the upstream extensionless relative imports to the pinned .js files.
